newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Compal plans $85 mln o'seas bond.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Compal plans $85 mln o'seas bond.

text.p: Taiwan computer and monitor maker Compal Electronic Inc said on Monday it would issue convertible bonds overseas to raise US$85 million for purchasing materials.

"We plan to issue the US$85 million worth of convertible bonds overseas around the end of this year or early next year, but details have yet to be set," company spokesman Lu Ching-hsiung told Reuters by telephone.
"The funds will be used to purchase needed raw materials abroad," Lu said.
Compal has appointed Jardine Fleming Securities as lead underwriter for its convertible issue, Lu said.

Convertible bond issues have increased rapidly in Taiwan since October 1993 when the central bank began allowing firms issuing bonds abroad to bring funds into the local economy for domestic investment.
